title: Progressive Compatibility Advisor and Self-Serve Upgrade Pathway
creator: Ava Patel
description: Build a cross-functional program that gives customers an automated, staged migration path when we deprecate or change model APIs and variants. This ticket scopes the product work for a Compatibility Advisor (in-console guidance + CLI) plus a Self-Serve Upgrade Pathway (release notes, migration guide, one-click migration steps and compatibility tests). Focus is on reducing manual support escalations, accelerating customer migrations, and preserving latency/cost SLAs by guiding customers to compatible model variants or runtime settings.
objectives: Provide in-console compatibility scoring per customer routes and model pins
Ship a self-serve migration flow that runs a dry-run compatibility test and produces recommended config changes
Automate release notes ingestion and map breaking changes to specific customer signals and suggested mitigations
Coordinate cross-team GTM assets (docs, changelog, customer comms, support runbooks) for the entire sunset window
tasks: Define compatibility scoring heuristics (model ops + request shape + third-party deps) - collaborate with Research/Eng
Prototype in-console advisor UI with prioritized recommendations - partner with Design (DES-1283) and Frontend ENG-5041
Build a dry-run compatibility runner (endpoint simulator + prefix/KV caching checks) - Backend ENG-4912
Author migration playbook templates and release note snippets for PM and Docs
Create a staged comms calendar (early notice, migration window, final cutoff) and templates for CSMs and support
Integrate advisor with billing signals to flag customers with high-cost mismatch risks
QA: run migrations against a sample of internal customers and record regressions
acceptance_criteria: Advisor surfaces a compatibility score and at least 2 actionable recommendations for 90% of customer routes in staging
Self-serve migration flow completes a dry-run and presents a clear rollback plan for customers
Release notes are automatically paired with advisor recommendations and linked in Console release view
Support tickets related to this deprecation category are reduced by 35% in the first 90 days in our pilot cohort
gtm_tasks: Finalize customer segmentation for pilot (top 50 customers by token volume and 10 high-risk customers)
Prepare customer-facing migration guide and annotated release notes
Enable one-click notify list for CSMs + automated email cadence
Train Support and Solutions engineering on how to interpret advisor output and run manual migration tests
Publish public blog + changelog entry summarizing what changed and recommended actions for developers
Coordinate Marketplace listing notes and partner communications for Managed/Private deployments
release_notes_plan: Release notes will be generated from a curated changelog feeder: each breaking change must include an impact level, mitigations, reproducible test case, and suggested config snippet. PM will own final approval; Docs will own formatting and publish pipeline. Release notes will ship as: 1) internal release digest (engineering + support), 2) console banner + advisor link, 3) public changelog and blog post.
communication_cadence:
- T minus 90 days: Initial advisory to affected customers (in-console + email)
- T minus 60 days: Technical migration guide + webinar invite for pilot customers
- T minus 30 days: Automated advisor runs and dry-run reports shared with customers
- T minus 14 days: Final reminder + scheduled migration assistance offers
- Cutover day: Console banner, support escalation channel active, rollback hotfix plan ready
- Post-cutover (D+7/D+30): Follow-up notes, regressions dashboard, and lessons learned writeup
rollback_criteria: Roll back the deprecation switch within 24 hours if more than 5% of pilot customers experience critical failures (error rates or latency breaches) attributable to the change and no immediate mitigation exists. Rollback must be coordinated with Eng, Infra, and SRE and followed by a hotfix and extended migration runway.
metrics: % of affected customers who complete self-serve migration
Support ticket volume related to this change (weekly)
Post-migration error and latency delta vs baseline
